why: The 9 September chart run flagged 87 library titles that are held only as a version by an act that never charted in Australia. All 87 were checked one at a time against the library. Most are not faults: some are a different song that happens to share a title (John Lee Hooker's Boom Boom is not Paul Lekakis's Boom Boom), some are the same recording under a different spelling of the act's name (Florence + the Machine and Florence and the Machine), and most of the rest are the famous original where the chart caught a later cover (Please Mr. Postman is The Marvelettes, Lady Marmalade is LaBelle). These are the ones where the library really does hold a recording the room would not know. Each keeps its song id and its place in every pack: only the artist, the preview clip, the cover art and the year change.

fixes.title: Sorrow
fixes.why: Bowie's Pin Ups reading is the one Australia heard. Bad Religion cut it for a 2002 punk album.

fixes.title: Rock Me
fixes.why: ABBA's Rock Me was an Australian number one in 1976. Great White's is a different band's 1987 album track.

fixes.title: Hurts So Good
fixes.why: John Cougar's 1982 single is the record. Astrid S released a same titled song in 2016 that never charted here.

fixes.title: I Finally Found Someone
fixes.why: The hit is Barbra Streisand with Bryan Adams from The Mirror Has Two Faces. The Lorrie Morgan and Sammy Kershaw cover did nothing here.

fixes.title: Angel of the Morning
fixes.why: The version Australia sings is Juice Newton's. Melinda Schneider and Beccy Cole cut a 2014 duet of it.

fixes.title: Harper Valley P.T.A.
fixes.why: Jeannie C. Riley's is the record that went to number one. Loretta Lynn's is an album cover.

fixes.title: The Real Thing
fixes.why: Russell Morris's 1969 single is one of the biggest Australian records ever made. Client Liaison is a 2016 synth pop act.

fixes.title: Little Lion Man
fixes.why: Twinkle Twinkle Little Rock Star is a lullaby covers project. This is a music box version of a triple j number one.
fixes.note: NOT SWAPPED: the AU store has no preview clip for Mumford & Sons' own recording, only lullaby and bluegrass covers. Left exactly as it was.

fixes.title: The Less I Know the Better
fixes.why: The library title literally says Tame Impala Cover. Tame Impala's own recording topped the Hottest 100.
fixes.note: NOT SWAPPED: the AU store has no preview clip for Tame Impala's own recording. Left exactly as it was.
